coordinateSummary.warning: All newly created positions are development-stage corridor reconciliations except the public Albir Garden anchor. They must be replaced with exact authoritative stop coordinates without changing composite IDs.

topologyDecisions: Line 010 is stored as two independently ordered open patterns: Benidorm to Altea and Altea to Benidorm.
Line 050 is stored as two independently ordered open patterns: Benidorm to L'Alfàs del Pi and L'Alfàs del Pi to Benidorm.
All four patterns use closesLoop false; no reverse sequence or last-to-first edge is inferred.
The shared Benidorm-to-Albir corridor is represented by exact shared composite StopNode identities where operator codes match.
Line 010 and Line 050 diverge after ALF 513: Line 010 continues toward Altea, while Line 050 continues via Camí de la Mar to L'Alfàs del Pi.
The same terminal StopNode may end one pattern and begin the opposite pattern without converting the pair into a closed cycle.
identityDecisions: All accepted shared objects are copied exactly from prior Benidorm scenarios.
BND 305/BND 222 and BND 218/BND 223 remain distinct directional identities despite paired corridor descriptions.
ALF 525 and ALF 555 remain distinct directional Casa de Cultura identities.
ALF 526 is shared exactly as the Line 050 terminal at the end of ida and start of vuelta.
ALT 411 is shared exactly as the Line 010 terminal at the end of ida and start of vuelta.
Every new StopNode receives a singleton StopPlace; proximity and paired street names do not merge identities.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform or stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.
